question: Should OpenClaw publish a public OpenAPI/Swagger contract for Gateway programmatic access, and if so should it be a static artifact, an authenticated runtime endpoint, or a documented TypeBox/JSON Schema generation path?
rationale: This would define supported external Gateway API, auth, endpoint visibility, versioning, and upgrade semantics, so automation should not choose the contract shape without maintainer intent.

options.title: Design Public Schema Contract First
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers choose schema format, exposure path, versioning model, and security boundary before implementation.

options.title: Narrow To Static Artifact
options.body: Publish a release-attached or committed schema artifact for client generation without adding a runtime endpoint yet.

options.title: Defer To Existing Protocol Docs
options.body: Close later only if maintainers decide the TypeBox/JSON Schema pipeline and Gateway protocol docs are the intended client-generation surface.

recommendation.title: Design Public Schema Contract First
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers choose schema format, exposure path, versioning model, and security boundary before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main history signal for the relevant schema, docs, generator, and HTTP route surfaces points to vincentkoc.
